name: Proof of claim
what: A creditor's filed statement of what a bankruptcy debtor owes it.

fields.label: Court and case number
fields.definition: The bankruptcy court and district, and the case number, from the notice of the case.

fields.label: Debtor
fields.definition: The debtor as named in the case, which may differ from the tenant or borrower name on the lease or loan.

fields.label: Chapter
fields.definition: The chapter the case was filed under, 7, 11, 13 or another, from the notice of the case.

fields.label: Creditor
fields.definition: The creditor to be paid, as the owning entity is named, and where notices and payments go.

fields.label: Petition date
fields.definition: The date the case was filed; every amount on the claim is stated as of this date.

fields.label: Filing deadline
fields.definition: The last day to file the claim, from the court's notice or order.

fields.label: Filed on and claim number
fields.definition: The date the claim was filed and the number it received on the court's claims register, with any amended claim listed after it.

fields.label: Amount of claim
fields.definition: The total claimed, and whether it includes interest, fees or other charges with an itemized statement attached.

fields.label: Basis of claim
fields.definition: What the claim arises from, such as a lease, money loaned or a guaranty.

fields.label: Secured amount
fields.definition: The part of the claim secured by a lien, with the property, its stated value and the basis for perfection, such as a recorded deed of trust.

fields.label: Unsecured amount
fields.definition: The part of the claim not secured; with the secured amount it equals the amount of claim.

fields.label: Amount to cure default
fields.definition: The amount needed to cure any default as of the petition date, for a secured claim or a claim based on a lease.

fields.label: Lease claim build-up
fields.definition: For a landlord: unpaid rent before the petition or surrender date, and damages for future rent after rejection, with the calculation of the limit applied and the security deposit held.

fields.label: Right of setoff
fields.definition: Whether the creditor claims a right of setoff, and the property or funds it identifies.

fields.label: Priority amount
fields.definition: Any part of the claim stated as entitled to priority, with the category checked, or zero.

fields.label: Supporting documents
fields.definition: The redacted documents attached, such as the lease, note, deed of trust, guaranty and an itemized statement of account.
